exp1.name: Text Input Display
exp1.description: Demonstrates React hooks (useState) with real-time text input/output binding. Learn how to manage component state and handle user input events.

exp10.name: API Data Fetching & Search Filtering
exp10.description: Fetch data from an API using class components and lifecycle methods. Learn state management with componentDidMount, componentDidUpdate, filtering, and searching through large datasets.

exp2.name: Header-Footer Component Composition
exp2.description: Illustrates breaking UI into reusable components and passing data via props. Master the fundamental pattern of component reusability and prop drilling.

exp3.name: Counter with Step Control
exp3.description: Demonstrates multiple state variables and state manipulation with conditional logic. Learn how to manage multiple independent pieces of state and handle user interactions.

exp4.name: Todo List Application
exp4.description: Explore array state management, CRUD operations, and toggling item states. Master the pattern of managing lists of data with add, update, and delete operations.

exp5.name: Image Gallery with Add/Remove
exp5.description: Build a dynamic image gallery component with add and remove functionality. Learn child-parent communication patterns and managing complex nested component state.

exp6.name: Advanced Form Validation & State Management
exp6.description: Demonstrates comprehensive form handling with React hooks, including state management, real-time validation, error display, and password visibility toggle. Learn to build robust forms with user-friendly validation feedback.

exp7.name: Profile Card with Hover Effects
exp7.description: Demonstrates component composition with props, useState for handling hover interactions, and dynamic inline styling. Learn to build reusable card components with interactive state-based visual feedback.

exp8.name: Task Reminder with Filtering
exp8.description: Build a task management system with add, filter, and completion tracking functionality. Demonstrates complex state management, array operations, conditional rendering, and filter logic in React.

exp9.name: Multi-Page Navigation with React Router
exp9.description: Build a multi-page application using React Router v6. Learn client-side routing, navigation between pages, and managing different components for different routes.
